safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (يوم) an adverb (ẓarf), the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); (جميعا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the third-person pronoun in (يحشرهم); (للملائكة) attached to (يقول); and (الهمزة) for interrogation; (إيّاكم) a detached pronoun in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi, the word governing it being (يعبدون).
The clause «(اذكر) يوم..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يحشرهم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «يقول ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause يحشرهم.
The clause «هؤلاء ... كانوا» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «كانوا يعبدون..» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هؤلاء).
The clause «يعبدون ...» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كانوا.

safi-cedvel:41-44.t:
* I'rab:
(سبحانك) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative; (من دونهم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the first-person pronoun in وليّنا [Note: The muḍāf ilayhi here is governed by the muḍāf, so it is its object; hence a ḥāl from it is permissible.]; (بل) for transitional digression (al-iḍrāb al-intiqālī); (بهم) attached to (مؤمنون).
The clause «قالوا..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «(نسبّح) سبحانك..» has no grammatical position: parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «أنت وليّنا ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «كانوا يعبدون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يعبدون الجنّ ...» is in the position of accusative as khabar (predicate) of كانوا..
The clause «أكثرهم بهم مؤمنون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or causal (taʿlīliyya) —
(42) (الفاء) a conjunction; (اليوم) an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative, attached to the negated (يملك); (لا) negative; (لبعض) attached to (يملك) by its being made to imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of "to present/offer" (يقدّم) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl from (نفعا).]; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasize the negation; (للذين) attached to (نقول); (التي) a relative noun in the position of genitive as naʿt (adjective) of النار; (بها) attached to (تكذّبون).
The clause «لا يملك بعضكم..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كانوا ...
The clause «نقول ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا يملك.
The clause «ظلموا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ذوقوا ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «كنتم بها تكذّبون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative noun (التي).
The clause «تكذّبون..» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كنتم.
(43) (الواو) resumptive; (عليهم) attached to (تتلى); (آياتنا) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (بيّنات) a ḥāl, accusative, from آياتنا; (ما) negative, inoperative (muhmala); (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (رجل) khabar of هذا, nominative; (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle; (عمّا) attached to (يصدّكم); and the noun (ism) of (كان) is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir), referring to (آباؤكم), so in the speech there is tanāzuʿ (two governors contending for one word).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن يصدّكم..) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being يريد.
(ما هذا إلّا إفك) like ما هذا إلّا رجل; (مفترى) naʿt of إفك, nominative; (للحقّ) attached to (قال) by its being made to imply the meaning of a verb that is made transitive by lām [Note: Or it has the sense of (في), i.e. they said concerning the truth, i.e. concerning its matter..]; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when" (حين), implying the sense of condition, attached to the implied apodosis; (إن) a particle of negation; (إلّا) for restriction; (سحر) khabar of هذا, nominative.
The clause «تتلى ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «قالوا....» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ما هذا إلّا رجل ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «يريد ...» is in the position of nominative as naʿt of رجل.
The clause «يصدّكم..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «كان يعبد ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يعبد آباؤكم ...» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كان.
The clause «قالوا ... (the second)» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا (the first).
The clause «ما هذا إلا إفك..» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «قال الذين....» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «جاءهم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis is omitted, i.e. when the truth came to them, those who disbelieved said ...
The clause «إن هذا إلّا سحر ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
(44) (الواو) resumptive; (ما) negative; (كتب) genitive in form, accusative in position, the second mafʿūl bihi; (ما) like the first; (إليهم) attached to (أرسلنا); (قبلك) an adverb, accusative, attached to (أرسلنا); (نذير) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi, its governor being أرسلنا.
The clause «ما آتيناهم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يدرسونها ...» is in the position of genitive — or accusative — as naʿt of كتب.
The clause «أرسلنا..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما آتيناهم.

* Rhetoric:
Repetition (al-takrīr): in the words of the Exalted «وَقالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جاءَهُمْ».
In the repetition of the verb, namely their saying, in the explicit mention of the disbelievers, in what the two lāms carry of pointing to those who said it and to what it was said about, and in what «لما» carries of haste in pronouncing this false statement decisively, there is a great condemnation of it and an eloquent expression of astonishment at it. This is to indicate the extent of the displeasure with them, contempt for their worth, and astonishment at the relapse of their minds, their recoiling from the truth and their effacing of its landmarks.

safi-cedvel:45-45.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (من قبلهم) attached to an omitted [element], the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun الذين; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (ما) negative, and the second is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the second object of the verb آتيناهم is omitted; (الفاء) a conjunction in both places; (كيف) an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as khabar (predicate) of كان; (نكير) the noun (ism) of كان, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which is omitted in observance of the verse-endings (fawāṣil) ...
The clause «كذّب الذين من قبلهم..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive [clause] [Note: In the previous verse (44).].
The clause «ما بلغوا ...» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: It may be parenthetical, and so have no grammatical position.].
The clause «آتيناهم ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «كذّبوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause كذّب الذين ...
The clause «كان نكير ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied clause, i.e.: when they denied My messengers, My disapproval came to them through punishment, so how was My disapproval.. i.e.: My disapproval was in its proper place.

* Morphology:
(معشار): a noun meaning a tenth, or a tenth of a tenth; some said it is a word equivalent to a tenth of the ʿashīr — and the ʿashīr is a tenth of a tenth. Its pattern (wazn) is مفعال; of the number words on this pattern none remains except it and المرباع.

safi-cedvel:46-46.t:
* I'rab:
(بواحدة) attached to (أعظكم) by its being made to imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of أوصيكم; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (لله) attached to (تقوموا).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن تقوموا) is in the position of genitive as badal (substitute) of واحدة [Note: Or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هي, and the clause is a naʿt of واحدة.
(2, 3) Or attached to an omitted naʿt of نذير.].
(مثنى) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, from the fāʿil (agent) of تقوموا; (تتفكّروا) accusative, conjoined to تقوموا; (ما) negative; (بصاحبكم) attached to a fronted khabar (predicate); (جنّة) genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (إن) a particle of negation; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (لكم) attached to the khabar نذير «2»; (بين) an adverb, accusative, attached to نذير «3».
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إنّما أعظكم ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «تقوموا..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «تتفكّروا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause تقوموا..
The clause «ما بصاحبكم من جنّة..» is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of reflection, suspended (muʿallaq) by the negation.
The clause «إن هو إلّا نذير ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

* Rhetoric:
Antithesis (al-ṭibāq): in the words of the Exalted «مَثْنى وَفُرادى».
A fine antithesis, brought to guard against standing up as a group, because in gathering together there is a confusion of thoughts and a blinding of insight, preventing contemplation and absorption in reflection; whereas their standing in pairs and singly allows them to think and to exercise deliberation, and if the truth becomes clear to the two, each individual inclines to exercising his own judgement.

safi-cedvel:47-47.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of accusative as a fronted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (سألتكم) in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (من أجر) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ما [Note: Or it is the tamyīz (specification) of (ما).]; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (لكم) attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هو; (إن) a particle of negation; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (على الله) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أجري; (الواو) a conjunction; (على كلّ) attached to the khabar شهيد.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما سألتكم من أجر ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «هو لكم..» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «إن أجري إلّا على الله ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the speech, for explanation.
The clause «هو ... شهيد» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the last resumptive clause.

safi-cedvel:48-48.t:
* I'rab:
(بالحقّ) attached to (يقذف), and (الباء) is causal [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied object of يقذف, and (الباء) is of accompaniment (mulābasa).. It is also permissible that (الباء) be instrumental (istiʿāna), so it is attached to (يقذف), i.e.: He hurls the truth at falsehood; or (الباء) is redundant (zāʾida) and the verb is made to imply the meaning of "casts" or "sends", like His words ولا تلقوا بأيديكم.. or the verb is made to imply the meaning of "judges" and "decrees"..]; (علّام) a second khabar (predicate), nominative.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إنّ ربّي ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «يقذف ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.

safi-cedvel:49-49.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction — or parenthetical — and the second is a conjunction; (ما) negative in both places; and the fāʿil (agent) of (يعيد) refers to الباطل.
The clause «قل..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «جاء الحقّ ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «ما يبدئ الباطل ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause جاء الحقّ [Note: Or parenthetical if the words are not part of the object of speech; or [ما is] a relative noun with the returning pronoun omitted.].
The clause «ما يعيد..» is conjoined to the clause ما يبدئ and takes its grammatical status.

* Rhetoric:
Metonymy (al-kināya): in the words of the Exalted «وَما يُبْدِئُ الْباطِلُ وَما يُعِيدُ».
I.e. it has gone and vanished, so that no trace of it remains. It is taken from the perishing of a living being: when it perishes, there remains for it no originating — i.e. doing something a first time — and no repeating — i.e. doing it a second time — as one says: "he neither eats nor drinks", i.e. he is dead. So the speech is a metonymy for what has been mentioned, or a figurative usage (majāz) branching from the metonymy.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(ضللت) in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (إنّما) the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (على نفسي) attached to (أضلّ); (اهتديت) like ضللت; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (إليّ) attached to (يوحي).
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (ما يوحي..) is in the position of genitive by (الباء), attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), and the mubtadaʾ (subject) is implied, its implied form being اهتدائي.
The clause «قل....» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إن ضللت ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «إنّما أضلّ....» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «إن اهتديت ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause ضللت.
The clause «يوحي ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما).
The clause «(يوحي) ربّي (اهتدائي)» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the second condition, joined with al-fāʾ.
The clause «إنّه سميع ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or causal (taʿlīliyya) —

safi-cedvel:51-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (إذ) an adverb borrowed for the future, attached to (ترى) [Note: Because of the certainty of its occurrence..]; and the object of ترى is omitted, its implied form being "their state" (حالهم); (الفاء) causal (taʿlīliyya); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (فوت) the noun (ism) of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of accusative, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "there is no escape for them"; (الواو) a conjunction; (من مكان) attached to (أخذوا ...).
The clause «ترى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "you would have seen a tremendous matter"..
The clause «فزعوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «لا فوت (لهم)..» has no grammatical position: causal.
The clause «أخذوا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause فزعوا.
(52) (به) attached to (آمنّا); (الواو) parenthetical; (أنّى) an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb (ẓarfiyya) — and it carries the meaning of "how" (كيف) — attached to the fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) التناوش; (لهم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from التناوش, and what governs it is the [implied] "being established" (al-istiqrār).
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause فزعوا..
The clause «آمنّا به ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
The clause «أنّى لهم التناوش ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
(53) (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (قد) a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (به) attached to (كفروا); (قبل) an adverbial noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of genitive, attached to (كفروا); (الواو) a conjunction; (بالغيب) attached to (يقذفون) by its being made to imply (taḍmīn) the meaning of "stone" (يرجمون) or "shoot" (يرمون); (من مكان) attached to (يقذفون).
The clause «كفروا ...» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl from the pronoun in (به) or from the fāʿil (agent) in (قالوا).
The clause «يقذفون ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause كفروا..
(54) (الواو) a conjunction in both places; and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb (حيل) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the maṣdar of the verb, i.e. "the intervening was made to intervene" (حيل الحول) [Note: Or the nāʾib fāʿil is the adverb, and in that case it is indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of nominative.]; (بينهم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (حيل); (بين), the second, conjoined to the first; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (ما), the second, likewise; (بأشياعهم) attached to (فعل); (كما) attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) governed by حيل, i.e. "an intervening was made like that which We did to their kind"; (من قبل) like the first, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of أشياعهم [Note: Or attached to (فعل).]; (في شكّ) attached to the khabar of كانوا ...
The clause «حيل بينهم ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause فزعوا..
The clause «يشتهون..» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (ما).
The clause «فعل ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «إنّهم كانوا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كانوا في شكّ..» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(فوت): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb فات يفوت, of the bāb of نصر; its pattern is فَعْل, with fatḥa then sukūn. There is another maṣdar, namely فوات, on the pattern فَعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(52) التناوش: a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the five-letter verb تناوش; its pattern is تفاعُل, with fatḥa on the tāʾ and ḍamma on the ʿayn.. Its meaning is taking hold of something, and thrusting at one another with spears and the like.. It was also said to mean returning or repentance.
(54) حيل: it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution (qalb). Its origin is حُوِل, with ḍamma on the ḥāʾ and kasra on the wāw — the alif in حال is originally a wāw — then the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the letter before it because of its heaviness on the wāw — iʿlāl by vowel-removal (taskīn) — then the wāw was changed into yāʾ because of the kasra before it.
(أشياعهم): plural of شِيَع, on the pattern فِعَل, with kasra then fatḥa, and شيع is the plural of شيعة..
See verse (65) of Sūrat al-Anʿām. The pattern of أشياع is أفعال ...

* Rhetoric:
Representative simile (al-tamthīl): in the words of the Exalted «وَأَنَّى لَهُمُ التَّناوُشُ مِنْ مَكانٍ بَعِيدٍ».
What is meant is likening their state — in seeking deliverance through faith after it has escaped them and become distant — to the state of one who wants to take hold of a thing after it has become distant from him and escaped him, in [its] impossibility.

* Benefits:
- The respects in which the (لا) of generic negation differs from (إنّ):
The (لا) of generic negation differs from (إن) in seven respects, namely:
1- (لا) only governs indefinite nouns, e.g. (لا كاذب محبوب), unlike إن. 2- Its noun is indeclinable (mabnī) if it is neither muḍāf nor resembling the muḍāf, as in the words of the Exalted:
يا أَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لا مُقامَ لَكُمْ.
3- That the nominative of its khabar, when its noun is single (not muḍāf), as in (لا رجل قائم), is by what made it nominative before lā entered, not by lā. This view is Sībawayh's; al-Akhfash and the majority differed from him. There is no disagreement among the Basrans that its nominative is by lā when [its noun] is a governing noun.
4- That its khabar does not precede its noun before the khabar has passed and after it. [Translator's note: The wording of this point appears garbled in the source (the phrase «قبل مضي الخبر وبعده» belongs to point 5); it is translated as written. The usual statement is that the khabar of lā may not precede its noun even if it is an adverb or prepositional phrase.]
5- That it is permissible to take account of its position together with its noun, before the khabar has passed and after it, so it is permissible to put the adjective and the conjoined noun in the nominative, e.g. (لا رجل ظريف فيها) and (لا رجل وامرأة فيها).
6- It may be rendered inoperative (ilghāʾ) if it is repeated, e.g. (لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله). You may give both nouns fatḥa, put both in the nominative, or differ between them.
7- That its khabar is frequently omitted, as in the verse we are dealing with (وَلَوْ تَرى إِذْ فَزِعُوا فَلا فَوْتَ), i.e. "there is no escape for them"; likewise the words of the Exalted قالُوا: لا ضَيْرَ, i.e. "no harm upon us"; and [the tribe of] Tamīm do not mention the khabar in that case.

safi-cedvel:12-14.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (لسليمان) attached to an omitted element, its implied form being سخّرنا ("We subjected"). (الواو) conjunction in all three places. (له) attached to (أسلنا). (من الجنّ) attached to a preposed khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (من) [Note: or attached to an omitted element, its implied form being: سخّرنا, in which case (من) is the direct object of the implied verb ... that is: We subjected to him those who work from among the jinn.]. (بين) an accusative adverbial attached to (يعمل). (بإذن) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of يعمل. (الواو) resumptive. (من) a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. (منهم) attached to a ḥāl of the agent of يزغ. (عن أمرنا) attached to (يزغ). (من عذاب) attached to (نذقه).
The clause «(سخّرنا) لسليمان ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «غدوّها شهر ... » is in the position of an accusative ḥāl from الريح.
The clause «رواحها شهر ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause.
The clause «أسلنا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause سخّرنا.
The clause «من الجنّ من ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause سخّرنا.
The clause «يعمل ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «من يزغ ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يزغ ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is possible that the khabar is both the protasis clause and the apodosis together.].
The clause «نذقه ... » has no grammatical position; the apodosis of a condition not joined by the fāʾ.
(13) (له) attached to (يعملون). (من محاريب) attached to a ḥāl from the omitted returning pronoun of the relative, that is: whatever he wills to be made. (كالجواب) naʿt (adjective) of (جفان). (آل) a vocative, a muḍāf (genitive construct) and accusative. (شكرا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar .. or a maṣdar in the position of a ḥāl .. or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) ... or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because شكر means obedience, figuratively.]. (الواو) resumptive. (قليل) a preposed khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الشكور). (من عبادي) attached to a naʿt of قليل.
The clause «يعملون ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يشاء ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «اعملوا ... » is in the position of an accusative, the reported speech of an implied "saying".
The clause «قليل ... الشكور» has no grammatical position; resumptive, giving a reason.
(الفاء) conjunction. (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of a condition, attached to the apodosis دلّهم. (عليه) attached to (قضينا). (ما) negative. (على موته) attached to (دلّهم). (إلّا) for restriction. (دابّة) agent of دلّ. (فلمّا) like the first, attached to (تبيّنت). (أن) the lightened form of the heavy (أنّ), its noun being an omitted pronoun, that is: أنّهم. (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (ما) negative. (في العذاب) attached to (لبثوا) [Note: or a ḥāl from the agent of لبثوا].
The clause «قضينا ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ما دلّهم ... إلّا دابة ... » has no grammatical position; the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تأكل ... » is in the position of an accusative ḥāl from دابة الأرض.
The clause «خرّ ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تبيّنت الجنّ ... » has no grammatical position; the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كانوا يعلمون ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of أن.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن لو كانوا ... ) is in the position of an accusative, direct object.
The clause «يعلمون ... » is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا.
The clause «ما لبثوا ... » has no grammatical position; the apodosis of لو.

* Morphology:
(غدوّها) the maṣdar of غدا يغدو, of the chapter naṣara; its pattern is فعول with two ḍammas, and the wāw of فعول was assimilated with the final radical.
(رواحها) the maṣdar of راح يروح; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(أسلنا) contains a weak-letter change by deletion, because of the construction on sukūn: the silent alif was deleted because it comes before the silent lām.
(13) جفان: plural of جفنة, a name for the large cooking pot; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa and sukūn, and the pattern of جفان is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ.
(الجواب) plural of جابية, a name for the large basin in which water is collected; its pattern is فاعله, and the pattern of جواب is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(قدور) plural of قدر, a name for the well-known vessel; its pattern is فعل with kasra and sukūn, and the pattern of قدور is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(راسيات) plural of راسية, feminine of رأس, an active participle from the triliteral رسا, pattern فاع - the word underwent a change because of the meeting of two silent letters - and the pattern of راسية is فاعلة.
(شكرا) the maṣdar of the triliteral شكر; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma and sukūn.
(14) الأرض: what may be meant by it is the well-known earth [Note: See verse (22) of Sūrat al-Baqara.], and what may be meant is the maṣdar of أرض يأرض, of the chapter fariḥa, meaning "to eat", as done by the termite (الأرضة), insects that gnaw wood; and دابّة has been made a muḍāf to the maṣdar, as if it had been said "the creature of eating". The pattern of الأرض is فعل with fatḥa and sukūn.. The first meaning is preferable, because the maṣdar of a verb of the chapter fariḥa comes on فعل with two fatḥas, and does not come on فعل with fatḥa and sukūn unless it is from the first or the fifth chapter, meaning "the herbage became abundant in the place".
(منسأة) a noun of instrument on the pattern مفعلة from the triliteral نسأ, meaning "to drive away and rebuke"; it means the staff, because it is the instrument of driving.

* Rhetoric:
Simile (tashbīh): in His saying, the Exalted, «يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُ ما يَشاءُ مِنْ مَحارِيبَ وَتَماثِيلَ وَجِفانٍ كَالْجَوابِ وَقُدُورٍ راسِياتٍ».
Here the large dishes are likened to great basins in their capacity and vastness. This is a simile of the sensed with the sensed, for both the likened and that to which it is likened are sensed.

* Benefits:
- Do the jinn know the unseen?
History records that in the time of Sulaymān ﷺ the jinn used to tell humans that they knew the unseen. So Sulaymān (peace be upon him) prayed to his Lord, saying: "O Allah, conceal my death from the jinn, so that humans may know that the jinn do not know the unseen." The jinn used to tell humans that they knew what would happen tomorrow. Sulaymān (peace be upon him) entered the prayer chamber as was his custom, and stood praying, leaning on his staff, and died standing. The chamber had openings, and the jinn carried on those hard labours which Sulaymān (peace be upon him) had charged them with, looking at him through the openings and supposing him alive; they did not find it strange that he stayed so long without coming out to the people, because of his habit in that and the length of his prayer. They remained after his death a long time, until the termite ate Sulaymān's staff and he fell down dead. Then they knew of his death, and at that the jinn knew that, had they known the unseen, they would not have stayed in toil and misery, subjected to Sulaymān while he was dead and thinking him alive. The historians mention that Sulaymān became king when he was thirteen years old and remained in kingship for forty years, began building the Holy House (Bayt al-Maqdis) four years after the beginning of his reign, and died aged fifty-three.

safi-cedvel:15-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الام) the lām of oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of affirmation. (لسبأ) attached to the khabar (predicate) of كان. (في مسكنهم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from آية. (جنتان) badal (substitute) for آية, nominative [Note: or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هي.]. (عن يمين) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (جنّتان). (من رزق) attached to (كلوا). (له) attached to (اشكروا). (بلدة) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هذه - or هي - and likewise (ربّ), the implied mubtadaʾ being المنعم.
The clause «كان لسبأ ... » has no grammatical position; the response to the implied oath.
The clause «كلوا....» is in the position of an accusative, the reported speech of an implied "saying".
The clause «اشكروا ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause كلوا..
The clause «(هذه) بلدة ... » has no grammatical position; giving a reason.
The clause «(المنعم) ربّ ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the causal clause.
(16) (الفاء) conjunction in both places. (عليهم) attached to (أرسلنا). (بجنّتيهم) attached to (بدّلناهم). (جنّتين) second direct object, its governor being بدّلناهم. (خمط) naʿt of أكل, genitive like it. (أثل) conjoined to أكل by the wāw, genitive, and likewise (شيء). (من سدر) attached to a naʿt of شيء. (قليل) naʿt of سدر, genitive [Note: or a naʿt of أكل, or of أثل.].
The clause «أعرضوا ... » is conjoined to the implied clause of saying.
The clause «أرسلنا ... » is conjoined to the clause أعرضوا.
The clause «بدّلناهم ... » is conjoined to the clause أعرضوا.
(17) (ذلك) a demonstrative, second direct object, its governor being جزيناهم. (ما) a maṣdar particle. (الواو) conjunction. (هل) an interrogative particle containing the sense of negation. (إلّا) for restriction ...
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كفروا) is in the position of a genitive, attached to (جزيناهم).
The clause «جزيناهم ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «نجازي ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جزيناهم.
(18) (الواو) conjunction. (بينهم) an accusative adverbial attached to an omitted second object, its governor being جعلنا. The second (بين) is conjoined to the first by the conjunction. (التي) a relative in the position of a genitive, naʿt of القرى. (فيها) attached to (باركنا), the second attached to (قدّرنا), and the third attached to (سيروا). (ليالي) an accusative adverb of time attached to (سيروا). (آمنين) an accusative ḥāl from the agent of سيروا.
The clause «جعلنا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جزيناهم.
The clause «باركنا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (التي).
The clause «قدّرنا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جعلنا.
The clause «سيروا ... » is in the position of an accusative, the reported speech of an implied "saying".

* Morphology:
(15) سبأ: see verse (22) of Sūrat al-Naml.
(16) العرم: plural of عرمة, on the pattern of كلمة, a name for what holds back water, of construction or otherwise, that is, the dam ... or it is the name of the valley in which the dam was built. The pattern of عرم is فعل with fatḥa and kasra.
(ذواتي) dual of ذوات, which is a singular noun containing a weak-letter change, because its origin is ذوية - with fatḥa on the dhāl, the wāw and the yāʾ - and it is the feminine of ذو, whose origin is ذوي. When the yāʾ received a vowel and what precedes it had fatḥa, it was turned into alif and became ذوات; then the wāw was deleted for lightness and it became ذات ... In the dual both ذاتان - on the deletion - and ذواتان - on the original - are correct.
(خمط) a name for every thorny tree whose taste has bitterness - it is said to be the arāk tree - and the word has been used as an adjective, so that أكل is described by it. Its pattern is فعل with fatḥa and sukūn.
(أثل) a name for a tree resembling the tamarisk but taller than it; it is a generic noun, the singular being أثلة. The pattern of أثل is فعل with fatḥa and sukūn.
(سدر) a generic noun for the nabq (jujube) plant; its pattern is فعل with kasra and sukūn.
(18) السير: the maṣdar of سار يسير, of the chapter ḍaraba; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa and sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- Congruence (mushākala): in His saying, the Exalted, «جَنَّتَيْنِ».
The art of mushākala is mentioning a thing by the word of another because it occurs in its company.
The replacement was called "two gardens" for the sake of mushākala, and in it is a kind of mockery of them.
2- Appended confirmation (tadhyīl): in His saying, the Exalted, «ذلِكَ جَزَيْناهُمْ», to the end of the verse.
The art of tadhyīl has two kinds: the first is what runs in the manner of a proverb, and the second is what does not come out in the manner of a proverb, which is that the second sentence depends on the first for conveying the intended meaning, that is: "And is anyone repaid with that particular repayment?". The content of the first sentence is that Allah the Exalted repaid the people of Sabaʾ for their disbelief, and the content of the second is that this particular punishment befalls only the ungrateful disbeliever. There is a difference between our saying "I repaid him because of such-and-such" and our saying "none is repaid with that repayment except one who was of that cause". Because they differ, the second may be made the reason for the first; but the difference of their meanings does not contradict one's confirming the other, through the necessity of the meaning.
3- Indefiniteness (tankīr): in His saying, the Exalted, «لَيالِيَ وَأَيَّاماً».
In making ليالي and أياما indefinite there is an allusion to the shortness of their journeys. They were short, because they were pasturing in the midst of a prosperous and ample life, not needing to keep up toil and bear the hardship of journeys in order to obtain what would make their life luxurious.

* Benefits:
- Sabaʾ and the flood of the dam (sayl al-ʿArim):
On the authority of Farwa al-Murādī, who said: When what was revealed about Sabaʾ was revealed, a man said: "O Messenger of Allah, what is Sabaʾ, a land or a woman?" He said: "It is neither a land nor a woman, but a man who had ten children among the Arabs.
Six of them went to the right (Yaman), and four went to the left (Shaʾm). As for those who went to the left, they are Lakhm, Judhām, Ghassān and ʿĀmila; and as for those who went to the right, they are the Azd, the Ashʿarīs, Ḥimyar, Kinda, Madhḥij and Anmār." A man said:
"O Messenger of Allah, and what is Anmār?" He said: "Those from whom come Khathʿam and Bajīla." Al-Tirmidhī reported it and said it is a good, strange (gharīb) ḥadīth. Sabaʾ is the son of Yashjub, son of Yaʿrub, son of Qaḥṭān.
Ibn ʿAbbās, Wahb and others said: They had a dam built by Bilqīs. She ordered their valley to be dammed with rock and pitch between the two mountains, and made for them three gates, one above the other, and built below it a huge pool, and made in it twelve outlets, according to the number of rivers, which they opened when they needed water. When the rain came, the waters of the valleys of Yemen gathered to them, and the torrent was held back behind the dam. They would begin the watering from the upper gate, then the middle, then the lowest, and the water would not run out until the dam filled from the next year's rain. When they transgressed and disbelieved, Allah was angry with them and prepared causes that led to the collapse of their dam; the water overflowed, their land and gardens were ruined, and they were drowned and scattered in every scattering, until they became a proverb among the Arabs, who say: "They went like the hands of Sabaʾ, and they dispersed like the hands of Sabaʾ."

safi-cedvel:19-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction. (ربّنا) a vocative, a muḍāf (genitive construct) and accusative. (بين) an accusative adverbial attached to (باعد). (أحاديث) second direct object, with an omitted muḍāf, that is:
"possessors of tales". (كلّ) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, accusative. (في ذلك) attached to an omitted khabar of إنّ. (اللام) for emphasis. (آيات) noun of إنّ, accusative, and its sign of accusative is the kasra. (لكلّ) attached to آيات - or to a naʿt of it -.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the implied clause of saying [Note: in the preceding verse (18)].
The clause of the vocative and its response ... is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «باعد ... » has no grammatical position; the response to the vocative.
The clause «ظلموا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause قالوا [Note: or conjoined to something implied, that is: they were insolent towards the blessing and wronged ... or it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) with an implied قد.].
The clause «جعلناهم ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause ظلموا.
The clause «مزّقناهم ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause جعلناهم.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.

safi-cedvel:20-21.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (عليهم) attached to (صدّق). (الفاء) conjunction. (إلّا) for exception. (فريقا) excepted, accusative. (من المؤمنين) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (فريقا).
The clause «صدّق عليهم إبليس....» has no grammatical position; the response to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «اتّبعوه ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause صدّق.
(21) (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) - or conjunction - (له) attached to the khabar (predicate) of كان. (عليهم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from سلطان. (سلطان) noun of كان, genitive in form, nominative in position. (إلّا) for restriction. (لام) for reason. (نعلم) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām. (بالآخرة) attached to (يؤمن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نعلم) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to سلطان.
(ممّن) attached to (نعلم), by its being given the sense of "We distinguish". (منها) attached to a ḥāl from شك. (في شك) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هو. (الواو) resumptive. (على كلّ) attached to the khabar حفيظ.
The clause «ما كان ... » is in the position of an accusative ḥāl from the latent agent pronoun in (اتبعوه) or from إبليس [Note: or it has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath.].
The clause «نعلم ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن) which is implied.
The clause «يؤمن ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the first relative noun (من).
The clause «هو منها في شك ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
The clause «ربّك ... حفيظ» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

safi-cedvel:22-23.t:
* I'rab:
(من دون) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of the omitted second object of the verb زعمتم, that is: you claimed them to be gods existing besides Allah. (في السموات) attached to (يملكون) [Note: or to an omitted element, a naʿt of مثقال ذرة.] and likewise (في الأرض), for it is conjoined to the first, and (لا) is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis of the negation. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negative, not operating. (لهم) attached to a preposed khabar (predicate). (فيهما) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from شرك [Note: or attached to the being (istiqrār) to which (لهم) is attached.]. (شرك) genitive in form, nominative in position, a postposed mubtadaʾ (subject). (ما له منهم من ظهير) like ما لهم فيهما من شرك ... and the pronoun in (له) refers to Allah, and in (منهم) refers to the gods.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «ادعوا ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «زعمتم ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لا يملكون ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption - not part of the reported speech -.
The clause «ما لهم ... من شرك» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا يملكون.
The clause «ما له ... من ظهير» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا يملكون.
(23) (الواو) conjunction. (لا) negative. (عنده) attached to (تنفع) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl from الشفاعة.]. (إلّا) for restriction. (لمن) attached to الشفاعة [Note: or it is a badal (substitute) for the excepted-from - with إلّا being an exception particle - by repeating the preposition, that is: intercession benefits no one except one for whom ... The implied excepted-from may be the one interceded for, with the intercessor omitted, indicated by the context, that is: intercession benefits none of those interceded for except one for whom He, the Exalted, has permitted the intercessors to intercede ... and it may be the intercessor, with the one interceded for omitted, that is: intercession benefits only through an intercessor who has been permitted to intercede.]. (له) attached to (أذن). (حتّى) a particle of commencement. (عن قلوبهم) deputy agent (nāʾib fāʿil) of the verb فزّع. (ماذا) an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative, direct object of the verb قال [Note: or (ما) is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and (ذا) a relative noun, khabar, with the returning pronoun omitted, that is: قاله ربّكم, and the nominal clause is the reported speech.]. (الحق) direct object of an omitted verb ... and it is originally a naʿt of an omitted modified noun, the implied form being: they said: He said the true word. (الواو) resumptive. (الكبير) second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو.
The clause «لا تنفع الشفاعة ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause لا يملكون.
The clause «أذن له ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «فزّع عن قلوبهم ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «قال ربّكم ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «قالوا (الثانية) » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «(قال) الحقّ ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «هو العليّ ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(شرك) a noun meaning the partner or associate, from (شركه يشركه) of the chapter fariḥa; its pattern is فعل with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:24-24.t:
* I'rab:
(من) an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). (من السموات) attached to (يرزقكم). (الله) the Name of Majesty, a nominative mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, indicated by the preceding speech, that is: Allah is your Provider. (الواو) conjunction. (أو) a conjunction for vagueness (ibhām). (إيّاكم) a detached pronoun in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the attached pronoun, noun of إنّ. (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). (على هدى) attached to the khabar of إنّ. (في ضلال) like على هدى, conjoined to it by (أو).
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «من يرزقكم ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «يرزقكم» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «قل (الثانية) ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «الله (رازقكم) » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «إنّا ... لعلى هدى ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause الله (رازقكم).

* Rhetoric:
1- Gradual leading on (istidrāj): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَإِنَّا أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلى هُدىً أَوْ فِي ضَلالٍ مُبِينٍ».
Here the opponent is led on gradually and compelled to submit and yield, and to give up stubbornness and contentiousness. When He had bound them with the argument, He addressed them with fair speech, of which one who is addressed with it says: "Your companion has been fair to you." Similar is a man's saying to his companion: "Allah the Exalted knows which of me and you is truthful, and one of us is surely lying."
2- Difference of particles (al-mukhālafa fī l-ḥurūf): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَإِنَّا أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلى هُدىً أَوْ فِي ضَلالٍ مُبِينٍ». In this verse there is a difference between the two prepositions, for they were made to differ in entering on truth and falsehood, because the possessor of truth is as if mounted upon a fine steed, galloping with it wherever he wishes, while the possessor of falsehood is as if immersed in a darkness, confused in it, not knowing in which direction to turn.

safi-cedvel:25-25.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) negative, and the wāw in (تسألون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (عمّا) attached to (تسألون), and the second attached to (نسأل); and the deputy agent of the verb (نسأل) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being نحن.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لا تسألون ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «أجرمنا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما), nominal or particle.
The clause «نسأل ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the reported speech.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the second relative (ما), which is like the first.

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(بيننا) an accusative adverbial attached to (يجمع), and the second attached to (يفتح). (بالحقّ) attached to (يفتح), by its being given the sense of "judges". (الواو) resumptive. (العليم) second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هو.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يجمع ... ربّنا» is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «يفتح ... » is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the reported speech.
The clause «هو الفتّاح ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الفتّاح) an intensive form from the triliteral فتح; its pattern is فعّال.

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(به) attached to (ألحقتم). (شركاء) ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted returning pronoun, that is: you attached them to Him as partners [Note: It is possible that it is a third object of the verb of seeing, the seeing being one of knowledge, the first object being the yāʾ of the speaker and the second the relative.]; it is barred from tanwīn because it is attached to the lengthened noun on the pattern فعلاء, with ḍamma then fatḥa. (كلّا) a particle of deterrence and rebuke [Translator's note: the source prints «حرف حرف», "particle particle", a doubled word]. (بل) for transitional rejection (iḍrāb). (هو) the pronoun of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). (الله) khabar (predicate), nominative. (العزيز) naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty, nominative. (الحكيم) second naʿt, nominative.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أروني ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «ألحقتم ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هو الله ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Rhetoric:
Figurative usage (majāz): in His saying, the Exalted, «أَرُونِيَ»:
The literal meaning of «أروني» is not intended, because he, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, did see them and knew them. So it is figurative and a representation (tamthīl).

safi-cedvel:28-28.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative. (إلّا) for restriction. (كافّة) ḥāl (circumstantial) from الناس, accusative [Note: al-Zamakhsharī rejected this analysis, claiming that a ḥāl may not come from a genitive noun that is placed after it; but some grammarians permitted it, such as Ibn ʿAṭiyya.. and al-Zamakhsharī parsed it as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is its description, that is: We sent you with a message that is universal for people, that is:
general for them, encompassing them ... and al-Zajjāj permitted (كافّة) to be a ḥāl from the kāf in] [Translator's note: the sentence breaks off here in the source]. (للناس) attached to the verb أرسلناك, the lām meaning "for the sake of" [Note: or attached to كافّة, if it is parsed as a ḥāl from the addressee kāf..]. (بشيرا) ḥāl from the pronoun of the addressee, accusative. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) negative.
The clause «ما أرسلناك إلّا ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لكنّ أكثر الناس ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لا يعلمون ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of لكنّ.

* Benefits:
- The ḥāl placed before and after:
The rank of the ḥāl is after its owner and after its governor; you say (جاء أخوك ضاحكا, "your brother came laughing"). It may be placed before one of them, or before both, so you say: (جاء ضاحكا أخوك), or (ضاحكا جاء أخوك). This permissibility has restrictions:
1- It must come after its owner when it is restricted, as in the noble verse we are dealing with, وَما أَرْسَلْناكَ إِلَّا كَافَّةً لِلنَّاسِ; and it must come before it when its owner is restricted, such as (ما جاء ضاحكا إلا أنت). If its owner is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive), it must come after, such as (أعجبني موقف أخيك معارضا), and likewise if it is governed by a preposition - according to most - such as (مررت بها مسرورة).
2- It must come after its governor when the governor is not a fully inflecting verb, or is an elative, such as:
(بئس المرء كاذبا) (أخوك خيركم كريما). Likewise when its governor is joined to something that has the right of first place, such as the lām of inception or the lām of oath, such as (لأنت مصيب موافقا) (لأبقينّ صابرا); or when it is the ṣila of (ال) or of a maṣdar particle, or an interpreted maṣdar, such as: (أنت السيد متواضعا) (يعجبني أن تقف محاميا) (يسوءني انقلابك خائنا).
The ḥāl that confirms its governor, and the clause joined with the wāw of ḥāl, do not precede their governor, such as: (ولّى مدبرا) (جئت والشمس مشرقة).

safi-cedvel:29-29.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (متى) an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative adverb of time attached to an omitted preposed khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هذا. (الوعد) badal (substitute) for the demonstrative - or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) - nominative. (كنتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ)..
The clause «يقولون ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «متى هذا الوعد ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position; parenthetical, between the question and the answer.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, that is the question before it.

safi-cedvel:30-30.t:
* I'rab:
(لكم) attached to a preposed khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ميعاد. (لا) negative. (عنه) attached to (تستأخرون). (ساعة) an accusative adverb of time attached to (تستأخرون). (لا تستقدمون) like لا تستأخرون.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لكم ميعاد ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «لا تستأخرون ... » is in the position of a nominative, naʿt (adjective) of ميعاد - or in the position of a genitive, naʿt of يوم.
The clause «لا تستقدمون» is conjoined to the clause لا تستأخرون.

safi-cedvel:31-31.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive - or conjunction - (بهذا) attached to (نؤمن). (الواو) conjunction. (لا) redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis of the negation. (بالذي) attached to (نؤمن), conjoined to (بهذا). (بين) an accusative adverbial attached to an omitted element, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. (الواو) resumptive. (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (إذا) an adverb borrowed for future time, attached to (ترى), for the certainty of the seeing. (عند) an accusative adverbial attached to (موقوفون). (إلى بعض) attached to (يرجع), and the wāw in (استضعفوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (للذين) attached to (يقول). (لولا) a non-jussive conditional particle. (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar omitted obligatorily, its implied form being موجودون. (اللام) the linking lām of the apodosis of لولا.
The clause «قال الذين ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: or conjoined to the clause يقولون in verse (29) of this sūra.].
The clause «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لن نؤمن ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «لو ترى ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive ... and the apodosis of لو is omitted, its implied form being "you would have seen a marvel".. and the object of ترى is omitted, that is: you would see the condition of the wrongdoers.
The clause «الظالمون موقوفون ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يرجع بعضهم ... » is in the position of a nominative, second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الظالمون) [Note: or in the position of an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in (موقوفون).].
The clause «يقول الذين ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
The clause «استضعفوا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «استكبروا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لولا أنتم ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «كنّا مؤمنين» has no grammatical position; the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(موقوفون) plural of موقوف, a passive participle from the triliteral وقف; its pattern is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:32-32.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for an interrogative of denial. (عن الهدى) attached to (صددناكم). (بعد) an accusative adverbial attached to the verb صددناكم. (بل) for transitional rejection (iḍrāb).
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «استكبروا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «استضعفوا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «نحن صددناكم» is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «صددناكم ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (نحن).
The clause «جاءكم ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «كنتم مجرمين» has no grammatical position; resumptive.

safi-cedvel:33-33.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive - or conjunction - (قال الذين ... استكبروا) like its counterpart before it [Note: in the preceding verse (32).]. (بل) for rejection (iḍrāb). (مكر) a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being صادّ ("a hindrance"), [Note: or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "the cause of our disbelief".. and it may be the agent of an omitted verb, its implied form being صدّنا ("hindered us")..]. (إذ) an adverb of past time attached to مكر. (أن) a maṣdar particle..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نكفر ... ) is in the position of an accusative, direct object, its governor being تأمروننا.
(بالله) attached to (نكفر). (نجعل) conjoined to (نكفر), accusative like it. (له) attached to a second direct object. (الواو) conjunction. (لمّا) an adverb containing the sense of a condition, in the position of an accusative, attached to the implied apodosis. (رأوا) a past verb, indeclinable on an implied ḍamma on the deleted alif, because of the meeting of two silent letters.. and the wāw is the agent. (في أعناق) attached to an omitted second direct object. (هل) an interrogative particle containing the sense of negation, and the wāw in (يجزون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (إلّا) for restriction. (ما) a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of a genitive by the omitted preposition, the returning pronoun omitted.] ..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا يعملون) is in the position of a genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being بما كانوا ...
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive [Note: or conjoined to the clause قال الذين in the preceding verse (32).].
The clause «استضعفوا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «استكبروا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «مكر الليل ... (صدّ) » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption, and the reported speech is omitted, its implied form being "We were not criminals, but ...".
The clause «تأمروننا ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «نكفر ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «نجعل ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause نكفر.
The clause «أسروا ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause قال الذين ... [Note: or in the position of an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) from those who were deemed weak and those who were arrogant.].
The clause «رأوا ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi ... and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
The clause «جعلنا ... » is in the position of a genitive, conjoined to the clause رأوا ...
The clause «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هل يجزون ... » has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption - or a giving of reason for what precedes -.
The clause «كانوا يعملون ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يعملون» is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(الندامة) a samāʿī (heard, non-systematic) maṣdar of the triliteral ندم, of the chapter fariḥa; its pattern is فعالة with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and there is another maṣdar of the verb, ندم, with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:34-35.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative. (في قرية) attached to (أرسلنا), by its being given the sense of "We sent". (نذير) genitive in form, accusative in position, direct object (mafʿūl bihi). (إلّا) for restriction. (إنّا) a particle resembling the verb, and its noun. (بما) attached to (كافرون), and the pronoun of the addressee in (أرسلتم) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (به) attached to (أرسلتم).
The clause «ما أرسلنا ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «قال مترفوها..» is in the position of an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) from قرية [Note: What permitted a ḥāl to come from an indefinite noun is its being in a negative context.].
The clause «إنّا ... كافرون» is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «أرسلتم به» has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
(35) (الواو) conjunction. (أموالا) tamyīz (specification), accusative. (ما) negative, operating like ليس. (نحن) noun of ما. (معذّبين) genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of ما.. and the sign of the genitive is the (yāʾ).
The clause «قالوا....» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause قال مترفوها.
The clause «نحن أكثر ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «ما نحن بمعذّبين» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the reported speech.

safi-cedvel:36-36.t:
* I'rab:
(لمن) attached to (يبسط). (الواو) conjunction in both places. (لا) negative ...
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «إنّ ربّي يبسط ... » is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «يبسط..» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «يشاء ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يقدر..» has no grammatical position; conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «لكنّ أكثر الناس..» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the reported speech.
The clause «لا يعلمون..» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of لكن.

safi-cedvel:37-37.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (ما) negative, operating like ليس. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis of the negation. (التي) a relative noun, whose near position is genitive and whose remote position is accusative, the khabar (predicate) of ما. (عندنا) an accusative adverbial attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (زلفى), which is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, so it is its synonym, accusative. (إلّا) an exception particle. (من) a relative noun in the position of an accusative by disconnected exception. (صالحا) mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative.], standing in for the maṣdar, so it is its description. (الفاء) resumptive. (لهم) attached to a preposed khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) جزاء. (ما) a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of a genitive, the returning pronoun omitted, and the clause is the ṣila.]. (الواو) conjunction. (في الغرفات) attached to (آمنون).
The clause «ما أموالكم ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تقرّبكم..» has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative التي.
The clause «آمن ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «عمل ... » has no grammatical position; conjoined to the clause آمن.
The clause «أولئك لهم جزاء ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «لهم جزاء ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما عملوا ... ) is in the position of a genitive by the (bāʾ), attached to جزاء.
The clause «هم ... آمنون..» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the khabar clause.

* Morphology:
(زلفى) a samāʿī (heard, non-systematic) maṣdar of the triliteral زلف, of the chapter naṣara; its pattern is فعلى with ḍamma and sukūn, meaning "nearness". There are two other maṣdars, الزلف with fatḥa and sukūn, and الزلف with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
Shift of person (iltifāt): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَما أَمْوالُكُمْ وَلا أَوْلادُكُمْ بِالَّتِي تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِنْدَنا زُلْفى».
A shift from the third person to the second, in a resumptive speech from the side of Him, Mighty and Majestic, with which people are addressed by way of variation and shift, as an exaggeration in realising the truth and confirming what preceded.

safi-cedvel:38-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (في آياتنا) attached to (يسعون), with an omitted muḍāf (genitive construct), that is: in invalidating Our signs. (معاجزين) an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of يسعون. (في العذاب) attached to the khabar (predicate) محضرون [Note: It is possible that it is attached to an omitted khabar, with محضرون a second khabar.].
The clause «الذين يسعون ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يسعون ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أولئك في العذاب....» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) الذين.
(قل إنّ ربّي ... يشاء) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (36) of this sūra.]. (من عباده) attached to a ḥāl from the omitted returning pronoun, that is: whomever He wills to provide, from among His servants. (له) attached to (يقدر). (الواو) conjunction. (ما) a jussive conditional noun in the position of an accusative, preposed direct object. (أنفقتم) in the position of a jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (من شيء) attached to a ḥāl from ما [Note: or a tamyīz (specification) of it.]. (الفاء) linking the apodosis, and (الواو) circumstantial or conjunction.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «إنّ ربّي يبسط» . is in the position of an accusative, reported speech.
The clause «يبسط....» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «يشاء ... » has no grammatical position; the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يقدر ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause يبسط.
The clause «أنفقتم..» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause of the reported speech.
The clause «هو يخلفه ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis joined by the fāʾ.
The clause «يخلفه ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو).
The clause «هو خير ... » is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause هو يخلفه [Note: or in the position of an accusative ḥāl from the agent of يخلفه.].

safi-cedvel:1-2.t:
* I'rab:
(لله) is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الحمد; (الذي) is in the genitive position, an adjective of the Name of Majesty; (له) is attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما); (في السموات) is attached to an omitted ṣila of ما; (ما في الأرض) is like ما في السموات, conjoined to it; (له الحمد) is like له ما في السموات; (في الآخرة) is attached to الحمد; (الخبير) is a second khabar, nominative..
The clause «له ما في السموات ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (ما). The clause «له الحمد ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «هو الحكيم..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
(2) (ما) is a relative noun in the accusative position, a direct object, whose governing verb is يعلم; (في الأرض) is attached to (يلج); the second (ما) is conjoined to the first ما; (منها) is attached to (يخرج); the third (ما) is conjoined to the first (ما); (من السماء) is attached to (ينزل); the fourth (ما) is conjoined to the first (ما); (فيها) is attached to (يعرج) ....
The clause «يعلم..» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يلج ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the third relative noun (ما).
The clause «يخرج ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the fourth relative noun (ما).
The clause «ينزل ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the fifth relative noun (ما).
The clause «يعرج ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the sixth relative noun (ما).
The clause «هو الرحيم..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause يعلم [Note: or in the accusative position, a ḥāl from the agent of يعلم.].

safi-cedvel:3-4.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive; (لا) is negative; (بلى) is a particle of response to affirm the negated; (الواو) is the wāw of the oath; (ربّي) is genitive through the (الواو), attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear"; (اللام) is the lām of the oath; (تأتينّكم) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the nominative position ... and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis and (كم) is a pronoun, a direct object; (عالم) is an adjective of (ربّي), genitive; (لا) is negative; (عنه) is attached to (يعزب); (في السموات) is attached to an adjective of (ذرة); (الواو) is a conjunction; (لا) is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis of the negation; (في الأرض) is like في السموات, conjoined to it; (الواو) is a conjunction; (لا) is like the last; (أصغر) is conjoined to مثقال, nominative [Note: or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is إلّا في كتاب, and the clause is conjoined to the clause لا يعزب.], and likewise (لا أكبر); (إلّا) is for restriction; (في كتاب) is attached to a ḥāl from مثقال or أصغر or أكبر.
The clause «قال الذين كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لا تأتينا الساعة ... » is in the accusative position, the quoted speech.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
The clause « (أقسم) بربيّ ... » is in the accusative position, the quoted speech.
The clause «تأتينّكم..» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the oath.
The clause «لا يعزب عنه مثقال..» is a ḥāl confirming the pronoun in عالم [Note: or in the accusative position, a ḥāl from ربّي.].
(4) (اللام) is the lām of reason; (يجزي) is an imperfect verb, subjunctive through an implied أن after the lām..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يجزي) is in the genitive position through the lām, attached to (تأتينّكم).
(لهم) is attached to an omitted fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ مغفرة; (رزق) is conjoined to مغفرة ...
The clause «يجزي ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle-type maṣdar (أن).
The clause «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أولئك لهم مغفرة..» has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
The clause «لهم مغفرة ... » is in the nominative position, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).

safi-cedvel:5-5.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive; (سعوا) is a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (في آياتنا) is attached to (سعوا), with an omitted muḍāf, that is, "in nullifying Our signs"; (معاجزين) is a ḥāl, accusative, from the agent of سعوا; (لهم) is attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ عذاب; (من رجز) is attached to an adjective of عذاب.
The clause «الذين سعوا..» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «سعوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أولئك لهم عذاب ... » is in the nominative position, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين.
The clause «لهم عذاب ... » is in the nominative position, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.

* Morphology:
(معاجزين): plural of معاجز, an active participle from the quadriliteral عاجز, its wazn being مفاعل (with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn).

safi-cedvel:6-6.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive, and the (الواو) in (أوتوا) is the deputy agent; (الذي) is a relative noun in the accusative position, a direct object of the verb of seeing, and the deputy agent of the verb (أنزل) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو, and it is the returning pronoun; (إليك) is attached to (أنزل), and likewise (من ربّك); (هو) is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl); (الحقّ) is a second direct object of the verb of seeing; (إلى صراط) is attached to (يهدي); (الحميد) is an adjective, genitive.
The clause «يرى الذين..» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «أوتوا..» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أنزل ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «يهدي..» is in the accusative position, conjoined to الحقّ.

safi-cedvel:7-8.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive; (هل) is an interrogative particle; (على رجل) is attached to (ندلّكم); (إذا) is an adverb that includes the meaning of a condition [Note: or free of the condition, attached to an omitted word, its implied form being: "You will be raised and gathered ..."], in the accusative position, attached to the content of the meaning of: في خلق جديد, that is, "you will be raised" [Note: It is attached to an omitted word and is not attached to خلق جديد because what comes after (إنّ) does not act upon what precedes it.]; (كلّ) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar because it is annexed to the maṣdar; (اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (في خلق) is attached to the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «قال الذين..» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «كفروا..» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «هل ندلّكم..» is in the accusative position, the quoted speech.
The clause «ينبّئكم..» is in the genitive position, an adjective of رجل.
The clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis.. has no grammatical position; it is parenthetical.
The clause «مزّقتم..» is in the genitive position, a muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّكم لفي خلق..» is in the accusative position, the second direct object of the verb ينبّئكم.. or it stands in for the second and third objects of the verb, and were it not for the lām in the khabar, the hamza of إنّ would be given a fatḥa.
(8) - (الهمزة) is for questioning, and it makes the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) unnecessary; (على الله) is attached to (افترى); (كذبا) is a direct object, accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar.]; (أم) is a conjunction; (به) is attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ جنّة; (بل) is for transition (iḍrāb intiqālī); (لا) is negative; (بالآخرة) is attached to the negated (يؤمنون); (في العذاب) is attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين..
The clause «افترى ... » has no grammatical position; it is a resumption within the sphere of the quoted speech [Note: or it is resumptive if it is from the speech of the hearers who answered the disbelievers.].
The clause «به جنّة..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause افترى..
The clause «الذين لا يؤمنون..» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «لا يؤمنون..» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).

* Morphology:
(ممزّق): a maṣdar mīmī of the quadriliteral مزّق, its wazn being مفعّل (with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn).

* Rhetoric:
Figurative attribution (al-isnād al-majāzī): in His saying, the Exalted, «وَالضَّلالِ الْبَعِيدِ».
Because "far" is an attribute of the one who strays, when he is far from the right path, and the farther he goes from it, the more astray he is.

safi-cedvel:9-9.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) is for reproachful questioning; (الفاء) is a conjunction; (إلى ما) is attached to (يروا) in the sense of "look"; (بين) is an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of ما; (الواو) is a conjunction; (ما خلفهم) is conjoined to ما بين and is parsed like it; (من السماء) is attached to a ḥāl from the two relative nouns; (بهم) is attached to (نخسف); (عليهم) is attached to (نسقط); (من السماء) is attached to an adjective of (كسفا); (في ذلك) is attached to the khabar of إنّ; (اللام) is for emphasis, it is the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ); (لكل) is attached to آية, or to an adjective of it.
The clause «لم يروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to an implied resumption, that is:
"Were they heedless, so did they not see?"
The clause «إن نشأ..» has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
The clause «نخسف..» has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of the condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «نسقط..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause نخسف.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآية..» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive, containing the sense of a reason.

safi-cedvel:10-11.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive; (اللام) is the lām of the oath for an implied oath; (قد) is a particle of confirmation; (منّا) is attached to a ḥāl from (فضلا), which is the second object; (جبال) is a vocative, a specific indefinite noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the accusative position; (معه) is an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the yāʾ in (أوّبي); (الواو) is the wāw of accompaniment; (الطير) is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), accusative [Note: It is permissible for it to be conjoined to (فضلا) with an omitted muḍāf, that is, "and the glorification of the birds".. as it is permissible for it to be a direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being "We subjected the birds" or "We called upon the birds to glorify with him".]; (له) is attached to (ألنّا).
(11) The clause «أتينا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the response to the implied oath.. and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The vocative clause «يا جبال..» is in the accusative position, the quoted speech of an omitted verb, its implied form being "We said".
The clause «أوّبي معه ... » has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
The clause «ألنّا..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause آتينا.
(أن) is an explicative particle [Note: It explains an implied meaning of saying without its letters, that is, "We commanded him: Make..". It is also permissible for (أن) to be a maṣdar particle, the interpreted maṣdar being in the genitive position through an omitted preposition attached to (ألنّا), that is: "We softened iron for him for the making of coats of mail".]; (في السرد) is attached to (قدّر); (صالحا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, so it is its adjective [Note: or a direct object, accusative.]; (ما) is a maṣdar particle [Note: or a relative noun in the genitive position, the returning pronoun being omitted, and the clause being a ṣila.].
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون) is in the genitive position through the bāʾ, attached to بصير.
The clause «اعمل ... » has no grammatical position; it is explicative.
The clause «قدّر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause اعمل.
The clause «اعملوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «إنّي.. بصير..» has no grammatical position; it is causal.
The clause «تعملون ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type maṣdar (ما).

* Morphology:
(سابغات): plural of سابغة, the feminine of سابغ meaning "ample"; it is an active participle from the triliteral سبغ, its wazn being فاعل.
(السرد): an aural maṣdar (maṣdar samāʿī) of the triliteral verb سرد, meaning "to weave a coat of mail", of the naṣara pattern and the ḍaraba pattern; and there is another maṣdar of the verb, سراد, on the pattern فعال (with kasra on the fāʾ).

* Benefits:
- The follower of the vocative:
1- If the follower of the vocative is a badal or a conjoined word, it is treated as an independent vocative, such as:
(يا أبا خالد سعيد) (يا خالد وسعيد) (يا عبد الله وسعيد). If the conjoined word is adorned with (ال), then it may be indeclinable on the ḍamma, following the form of the word conjoined to, or accusative, following the position. And that is as occurs in the verse we are dealing with: يا جِبالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ; for الطير the ḍamma is permissible following the form of الجبال, and the accusative is permissible following the position of الجبال.
2- As for the adjective, the ʿaṭf bayān and the tawkīd, they must be accusative if they are annexed and free of (ال), such as: (يا أحمد صاحب الدار) (يا عليّ أبا حسن).
But if this follower is adorned with (ال), or is a tawkīd that is not annexed, then the accusative is permissible, regarding the position, and the nominative, regarding the form: (يا أحمد الكريم) (يا سليم سليما أو سليم).
3- The follower of an accusative vocative is always accusative: (يا عبد الله الكريم) (يا عبد الله والنجار).
